# A test's change or input on a widget bound two-way to a var runs the
# effects keyed on that var, as a handler's write does: the component's own
# `@update`, and one a child bound to the same var holds.
#
# bubbletea wrote the widget's value back with a bare assignment taken from
# the bind's handler, dropping the marks and the settle the effect lowering
# had put after it, so the var moved and no `@update` ran -- for a key in
# Update as for a test.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var saves = 0

component keep(:value string) ui.node {
    effect(on=value, @update(v) { saves += 1 })
}

component app ui.node {
    var language = "English"
    var name = ""
    var updates = 0
    var renames = 0

    effect(on=language, @update { updates += 1 })
    effect(on=name, @update { renames += 1 })
    ui.vbox {
        keep(:value=language)
        ui.select #pick(:value=language) {
            ui.choice(label="English", value="English")
            ui.choice(label="Deutsch", value="Deutsch")
        }
        ui.input #field(:value=name)
    }
}

func testAPickRunsTheUpdates(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.pick.change("Deutsch")
    t.assert(c.language == "Deutsch")
    t.assert(c.updates == 1)
    t.assert(saves == 1)
}

func testTypingRunsTheUpdate(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.field.input("Ada")
    t.assert(c.name == "Ada")
    t.assert(c.renames == 1)
}
